title: THE FOUNDING ADDRESS
setup: Day one. Barry addresses the company for eleven minutes. The product is never named.

lines.txt: The boardroom. All hands. Barry stands. The putter is present for reasons no one will ever learn.
Folks. Let me tell you a story. A man builds a ship. The ship is an orchard. The orchard — and this is the part they don't teach you — is also a ship.
People ask what we make here. And I tell them: we make BELIEVERS.
(typing) okay so the caption is 'day one energy' and honestly? it is
Chief, if I can add — the strategy is simple. We hold the line, we take this thing [REDACTED], and—
I'm going to keep this page.
The bar sweeps in mid-sentence. The chime. The silence.
…Beautifully said, both of you. Q3 was a donation to our future. Meeting adjourned.
It is day one. There has been no Q3. Nobody questions the tense.
